- Jul 25 Long Run: cut from planned 120 to 30 min — head cold, HR drifting high for pace.
- Jul 29 Easy Run: cut from 60 to 45 min — travel week, hotel treadmill.
- Aug 1 Long Run (120 planned) shows as not completed — no log yet, so it's not counting toward Z2 at all right now.

Net effect: acute 7-day load 45 min vs chronic weekly avg 131 (ratio 0.34) — real deload, not just logging gaps. Block attainment is 525/960 min (55%) through week 5.

Doctrine point (aerobic-base): the base phase is about closing the AeT gap with high Z2 volume — missed weeks get extended, not crammed. If Aug 1 actually happened, log it so the numbers reflect reality; otherwise treat this week as a rebuild week and don't try to make up the deficit by overloading Tue/Sat.
